name: Modest Coverage

intent_defaults.description: A user-directed coverage and layering starting point. The wearer defines coverage, opacity, movement and styling preferences.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-defined coverage and silhouette; no assumptions about religion, gender or culture.

component_defaults.coverage: User-defined body coverage zones and lengths
component_defaults.layering: Optional coordinated base and outer layers

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Coverage preferences must be provided by the wearer; no religious or cultural identity is inferred.
Opacity and coverage depend on material, light, construction and movement and should be tested.
